description: This PHP class 'AttendanceHelper' provides utility functions for managing timezone offsets related to attendance records in the OrangeHRM system's migration version 5.0.0. It contains a timezone map and methods to update punch-in and punch-out timezone offsets in the database.

classes.name: AttendanceHelper
classes.description: A helper class responsible for updating punch-in and punch-out timezone offsets in the attendance records within the database during migration process.

methods.name: updatePunchInTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-in timezone name in the 'ohrm_attendance_record' table based on a given offset and timezone.

methods.name: updatePunchOutTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-out timezone name in the 'ohrm_attendance_record' table based on a given offset and timezone.
